name: Curvy Liger 67
author: JkHuger
description: Rounded white toggle switch that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: Clicking it toggles it: transform becomes rotate(35deg) scaleX(.55) translate(39px, -4.5px), border-radius becomes 50px 50px 50px 0, transform becomes rotate(-35deg) scaleX(.55) translate(39px, 4.5px).
